Author: Anuradha Shukla
Bench: Anuradha Shukla

 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh

Before
 Hon'Ble Smt. Justice Anuradha Shukla

On The 8 th Of July, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 28025 of 2025
 Shravan Khairwar
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri Ram Narayan Shah - Advocate for applicant.
 Shri Ravindra Rajpoot - Panel Lawyer for respondent/State.
 Order

This is second bail application filed by applicant Shravan Khairwar under Section 483 of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure 1973) for grant of bail relating to FIR/Crime No.641/2023, dated 19.09.2023, registered at Police Station,
Mada, district Singrauli, for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(3), 376(2)(N) of IPC, Section 5/6 of POCSO Act.
His first application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 06.08.2024 under M.Cr.C. No.18539/2024.
This second application has been argued on the ground that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.

The victim was above 18 years of age and was a consenting party, who had stayed with the applicant for more than 3 months and upon her insistence to go back to her parents, applicant took her to her parental house.
It is claimed that from the statements of parents and guardian as well as the teacher of the school, the 2 MCRC-28025-2025 age of prosecutrix has not been proved below 18 yeas.
For this reliance has been placed upon the certified copy of the statements of these witnesses.
A request has, therefore, been made to release the applicant on bail.
State has opposed the bail application on the ground that DNA report was positive in this case and the victim was below the age of 18 years, therefore, her consent was immaterial.
A request has been made to dismiss the application.

Counsel for both the sides have been heard and the record has been perused.
Having considered the facts argued here by counsel for the applicant regarding the age of Shravan Khairwar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/79252459/
1 prosecutrix in the light of certified copy of the statements, but without commenting on merits of the case, this bail application is allowed.
It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during pendency of the trial.
